newsitem.title: EGYPT: South Cairo Mills Q1 profit slightly down.
newsitem.headline: South Cairo Mills Q1 profit slightly down.

text.p: South Cairo Flour Mills made pre-tax profits of 7.2 million pounds ($2.1 million) in the first three months of the financial year 96/97, slightly down from 7.4 million in the same period of the previous year, the specialist weekly al-Boursa said on Monday.
The financial years end on June 30.
The unaudited figures showed sales rose to 80.7 million pounds in the July-September period from 66.5 million in the first quarter of 95/96, al-Boursa said.
The weekly attributed the sales increase to rising production of subsidised wheat.

The miller's unaudited net profits in the whole of 95/96 rose to 21.32 million pounds from 19.23 million in the previous year, it said. The firm expected the shareholders' part of the profits to be 9.75 million pounds, equivalent to 3.25 pounds for each of the three million shares.
The state sold a large block of shares in South Cairo in May at 26.00 pounds. They last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange on Monday at 60.00.
